blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Filipino tennis star Alex Eala opens her 2026 Ningbo Open campaign against Diane Parry of France in the first round. The Ningbo Open announced the matchups on its official social media accounts Saturday. The main draw begins on Monday. READ: Alex Eala tries to get back on track in final stretch of season This will be Eala and Parry’s first meeting on the WTA Tour, but both players captured their maiden WTA titles this year. Eala won the DC Open, while Parry ruled Monterrey during the North American swing ahead of the 2026 US Open. Both were also former top-five […]...
